Overview

Ghost-kun (Bound) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable by evolving Ghost-kun.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • This unit currently deals 3x its displayed damage at upgrade 6-8. (Its Burn isn't affected by this.)
    • At base max upgrade, the combined damage per second ( DPS ) with his burn and his x3 displayed dmg is 45,099.92. However, with the infernal gaze relic equipped, his DPS will increase to 51,542.76 having a total damage per second ( TDPS ) of 154,628.29.
